# OMSINFO

List the OMS requests in force.

## Syntax

```text
OMSINFO.
```

A table with a row per request: its tag, the kinds it chooses, its format, its file and whether the chosen items still show in the results.

## Example

```text
OMSINFO.
```

`statscraft help OMSINFO` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
